description: This file defines the Properties class responsible for loading and setting document properties from an ODS spreadsheet XML structure into a PhpSpreadsheet Spreadsheet object.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: A class to load and set document properties from an ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) XML structure into a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Properties object with a Spreadsheet instance.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and processes XML data to set various document properties.

methods.name: setCoreProperties
methods.description: Sets core document properties like title, subject, creator, date, description.

methods.name: setMetaProperties
methods.description: Sets additional metadata properties such as creator, keywords, creation date, and user-defined.

methods.name: setUserDefinedProperty
methods.description: Handles setting user-defined custom properties based on XML attributes.
